_about: What the model finder shows that no launch file holds. Keyed by preset id, Strata size or ninfer profile; model-catalog.ps1 adds context, images, GPUs and thinking from the launch files. speed is net tok/s at 2k context (code, prose) from README.md: the router rows are one short reply each (README § The models), the Strata and ninfer rows the newest bench-depth run of their section. family groups the lanes of one model, which share its benchmark scores.

qwen3.8-27b.description: Default. Best all-rounder, the most-validated config (MTP drafter).

qwen3.8-27b-dflash2.description: Qwen3.8-27B with the DFlash2 drafter: faster than the default, most at long context.

swift-qwen3.8-27b-dflash2.description: Swift 1.5: Qwen3.8-27B retrained to think less, with DFlash2. The daily coding agent.

swift-qwen3.8-27b.description: Swift 1.5 with the built-in MTP drafter; faster only for short prose chats.

qwen3.8-27b-nopreserve.description: Qwen3.8-27B like the default, but earlier turns' thinking is dropped from the prompt (BoxelBuilder).

qwen3.6-35b-a3b.description: Older Qwen MoE, very fast (3B active). Qwen3.8 is better.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-dflash.description: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, text only, with a DFlash drafter: much faster on code, slower on prose.

qwen3-coder-30b-dflash.description: Qwen3-Coder-30B with a DFlash drafter: much faster on code, much slower on prose.

gemma4-31b.description: Google Gemma 4, dense; its heavy KV cache keeps the context short.

gemma4-31b-mtp.description: Gemma 4 31B with an MTP drafter: faster on code and prose.

gemma4-26b-a4b.description: Google Gemma 4 MoE; the long-context Gemma.

gemma4-26b-a4b-dflash.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B with a DFlash drafter: much faster on code, slower on prose.

muse-glimmer-30b.description: Strong reasoner with a DFlash drafter; always reasons. GPU 1 only, about 1 GB spare.

ornith-35b.description: Fast MoE with a built-in MTP drafter.

qwen3.8-27b-single.description: The default model's Q4_K_XL on GPU 1 alone, text only; for when GPU 0 is reserved.

gemma4-26b-a4b-single.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B on GPU 1 alone, text only, at its full context.

swift-iq3_s.description: Strata's default: Swift 1.5 of the 125B Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MoE, IQ3_S. The biggest local model; shorter thinking.

iq3_xxs.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B on Strata, IQ3_XXS: the fastest Strata size, reads long prompts 1.4-2.5x faster than Swift.

unsloth-ud-q4_k_xl.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B, Unsloth 4-bit: the most accurate Strata quant, slower, leaves ~4 GB of RAM (use the memory saver).

inkling-2-mini-sq-20.description: Inkling 2 Mini, lossless SQ-20, on Strata across both GPUs.

inkling-2-mini-sq-20-gpu1.description: Inkling 2 Mini SQ-20 on Strata, GPU 1 alone (the cache spills to RAM past ~56k tokens). Not in the tray menu.

inkling2-mini.description: Inkling 2 Mini UD-IQ4_XS on ninfer, GPU 1 alone.

inkling2-mini-2gpu.description: Inkling 2 Mini UD-IQ4_XS on ninfer across both GPUs: the longest context here.

inkling2-mini-q8.description: Inkling 2 Mini UD-Q8_K_XL on ninfer, both GPUs: closer to full precision.

qwen38-27b.description: Qwen3.8-27B on ninfer, GPU 1: the fastest single stream (a ~4-bit conversion; quality not compared).
